@graph.name: RO-Crate Metadata Descriptor
@graph.rdfs:label: CreativeWork
@graph.rdfs:comment: The entity that identifies the crate and points at its root data entity.

@graph.name: Main collection root
@graph.rdfs:label: Dataset
@graph.rdfs:comment: The root dataset of a rocphotos Main Collection, which includes references to all the "folder collections". This has the metadata for the Main Collection, which also includes detailed context such as relationships between people.
@graph.description: The root dataset of a rocphotos Main Collection, which includes references to all the "folder collections". This has the metadata for the Main Collection, which also includes detailed context such as relationships between people.

@graph.name: Folder collection root
@graph.rdfs:label: Dataset
@graph.rdfs:comment: The root dataset of a Folder Collection - describing all the images in a directory and its sub-directories.
@graph.description: The root dataset of a Folder Collection - describing all the images in a directory and its sub-directories.

@graph.name: Faces crate root
@graph.rdfs:label: Dataset
@graph.rdfs:comment: This is used by the rocphotos app for managing face data - it is not designed to be edited by people.
@graph.description: This is used by the rocphotos app for managing face data - it is not designed to be edited by people.

@graph.name: Sub-collection reference
@graph.rdfs:label: Dataset
@graph.rdfs:comment: A reference to a Folder Collection from the Main Collection, just a pointer to where it is on disk. This is not intended to be edited by hand.
@graph.description: A reference to a Folder Collection from the Main Collection, just a pointer to where it is on disk. This is not intended to be edited by hand.

@graph.name: Photo
@graph.rdfs:label: ImageObject
@graph.rdfs:comment: A photograph. Distinguished from the crate's other ImageObjects (thumbnails, album items).
@graph.description: A photograph. Distinguished from the crate's other ImageObjects (thumbnails, album items).

@graph.name: Thumbnail
@graph.rdfs:label: ImageObject
@graph.rdfs:comment: A generated thumbnail, referenced by a photo's thumbnail property.
@graph.description: A generated thumbnail, referenced by a photo's thumbnail property.

@graph.name: Album item
@graph.rdfs:label: ImageObject
@graph.rdfs:comment: A proxy reference to a photo in an album so a caption or other metadata specific to this album can later be added without changing the original picture.
@graph.description: A proxy reference to a photo in an album so a caption or other metadata specific to this album can later be added without changing the original picture.

@graph.name: Album
@graph.rdfs:label: ImageGallery
@graph.rdfs:comment: A named, ordered virtual collection of photos, which is stored in the Main Collection crate.
@graph.description: A named, ordered virtual collection of photos, which is stored in the Main Collection crate.

@graph.name: Person
@graph.rdfs:label: Person
@graph.rdfs:comment: A person, identified by name across the whole collection using an id that is unique within the collections (eg arcp://name,rocphoto/person/<NameSlug>). The Main Crate has the 'canonical' or main description for each unique person represented in the collection.
@graph.description: A person, identified by name across the whole collection using an id that is unique within the collections (eg arcp://name,rocphoto/person/<NameSlug>). The Main Crate has the 'canonical' or main description for each unique person represented in the collection.

@graph.name: Person in this crate
@graph.rdfs:label: Person
@graph.rdfs:comment: A person as depicted in one crate — one per person per crate, which everything in that crate points at rather than the shared identity. Lets the same person be recorded under the name they went by in this part of the collection.
@graph.description: A person as depicted in one crate — one per person per crate, which everything in that crate points at rather than the shared identity. Lets the same person be recorded under the name they went by in this part of the collection.

@graph.name: Pet
@graph.rdfs:label: rocp:Pet
@graph.rdfs:comment: A pet, identified by name the same way a Person is, in its own id space so the two never collide.
@graph.description: A pet, identified by name the same way a Person is, in its own id space so the two never collide.

@graph.name: Pet in this crate
@graph.rdfs:label: rocp:Pet
@graph.rdfs:comment: A pet as depicted in one crate — see Person in this crate.
@graph.description: A pet as depicted in one crate — see Person in this crate.

@graph.name: Region (from the file's own tags)
@graph.rdfs:label: ImageRegion
@graph.rdfs:comment: A face or pet tagged in the photo file itself (MWG), rebuilt from EXIF on every rescan. Its area is MWG's own convention: a centre point plus size, as fractions of the image.
@graph.description: A face or pet tagged in the photo file itself (MWG), rebuilt from EXIF on every rescan. Its area is MWG's own convention: a centre point plus size, as fractions of the image.

@graph.name: Region (confirmed here)
@graph.rdfs:label: ImageRegion
@graph.rdfs:comment: A face confirmed in this application, recorded whether or not it is ever written into the photo file. Typed as a Web Annotation as well as an ImageRegion, which is what tells it apart from the EXIF-derived shape.
@graph.description: A face confirmed in this application, recorded whether or not it is ever written into the photo file. Typed as a Web Annotation as well as an ImageRegion, which is what tells it apart from the EXIF-derived shape.

@graph.name: Region body
@graph.rdfs:label: Person
@graph.rdfs:comment: The body of a standoff region: a proxy for the subject, specializing this crate's instance of them (which in turn specializes the shared identity).
@graph.description: The body of a standoff region: a proxy for the subject, specializing this crate's instance of them (which in turn specializes the shared identity).

@graph.name: EXIF value
@graph.rdfs:label: PropertyValue
@graph.rdfs:comment: One EXIF field, with a stable id so a rescan overwrites it rather than accumulating a new node.
@graph.description: One EXIF field, with a stable id so a rescan overwrites it rather than accumulating a new node.

@graph.name: Face embedding
@graph.rdfs:label: FaceEmbedding
@graph.rdfs:comment: One reference embedding in the faces crate, for inspection — matching itself queries the companion SQLite index. Points back at the region it came from rather than holding image data.
@graph.description: One reference embedding in the faces crate, for inspection — matching itself queries the companion SQLite index. Points back at the region it came from rather than holding image data.

@graph.name: Spouses
@graph.rdfs:label: rico:SpouseRelation
@graph.rdfs:comment: Relationship between people who are, or were, in a spousal relationship to each other, includes marriages, de-facto marriages and other long term partnerships.
@graph.description: Relationship between people who are, or were, in a spousal relationship to each other, includes marriages, de-facto marriages and other long term partnerships.

@graph.name: Parent and child
@graph.rdfs:label: rico:ChildRelation
@graph.rdfs:comment: A parent-child relationship including biological, adoptive or other forms.
@graph.description: A parent-child relationship including biological, adoptive or other forms.

@graph.name: @id
@graph.rdfs:label: @id
@graph.rdfs:comment: Always ro-crate-metadata.json.

@graph.name: About
@graph.rdfs:label: about
@graph.rdfs:comment: The one root data entity of this crate. Exactly one value, which must have the shape of one of the three kinds of root.

@graph.rdfs:comment: The name of the collection, folder or crate.

@graph.name: Has part

@graph.name: Name
@graph.rdfs:label: name
@graph.rdfs:comment: The name of the collection, folder or crate.

@graph.name: Has part
@graph.rdfs:label: hasPart

@graph.name: Name

@graph.rdfs:comment: The name of the collection, folder or crate.

@graph.name: Has part

@graph.name: Name

@graph.rdfs:label: name

@graph.name: Title

@graph.name: Description

@graph.name: Date created
@graph.rdfs:label: dateCreated
@graph.rdfs:comment: From EXIF DateTimeOriginal.

@graph.name: Date modified
@graph.rdfs:label: dateModified
@graph.rdfs:comment: The source file's modification time when last processed — what a rescan compares against to decide whether to re-read it.

@graph.name: Keywords
@graph.rdfs:label: keywords
@graph.rdfs:comment: IPTC/XMP keywords, excluding any that duplicate a region's name.

@graph.name: Rating
@graph.rdfs:label: rating

@graph.name: EXIF data

@graph.name: Regions

@graph.name: Thumbnail

@graph.rdfs:comment: The generated thumbnail.

@graph.name: Processing error

@graph.name: Name

@graph.rdfs:comment: e.g. "Thumbnail of IMG_0042.jpg".

@graph.name: Specialization of
@graph.rdfs:label: prov:specializationOf

@graph.name: Name
@graph.rdfs:label: name
@graph.rdfs:comment: The album's name, from which its id is derived.

@graph.rdfs:label: name
@graph.rdfs:comment: How they were known here.

@graph.rdfs:label: prov:specializationOf
@graph.rdfs:comment: The shared identity this is an instance of.

@graph.name: Name
@graph.rdfs:label: name
@graph.rdfs:comment: The subject's name, duplicated here so a reader need not resolve about.

@graph.rdfs:label: about
@graph.rdfs:comment: Who this region depicts, via the crate's instance of them.

@graph.name: X position
@graph.rdfs:label: xPosition
@graph.rdfs:comment: The region's centre X, as a fraction of the image.

@graph.name: Y position
@graph.rdfs:label: yPosition
@graph.rdfs:comment: The region's centre Y, as a fraction of the image.

@graph.name: Width

@graph.name: Height

@graph.rdfs:comment: The region's height, as a fraction of the image.

@graph.name: Region type
@graph.rdfs:label: regionType
@graph.rdfs:comment: A literal, either "Face" or "Pet".

@graph.name: Has target
@graph.rdfs:label: oa:hasTarget
@graph.rdfs:comment: A W3C Media Fragment on the photo — #xywh=percent:x,y,w,h, a top-left corner and size, unlike the centre-based EXIF shape.

@graph.name: Has body
@graph.rdfs:label: oa:hasBody
@graph.rdfs:comment: A per-region proxy for the subject, so this one sighting could later carry its own properties.

@graph.name: Motivated by
@graph.rdfs:label: oa:motivatedBy
@graph.rdfs:comment: Always oa:identifying — the annotation says who this is. The value comes from an ItemList so more motivations can be added later. As with any ItemList value, the crate must carry the oa:identifying entity itself, matching the one in this profile.

@graph.name: Written to file
@graph.rdfs:label: writtenToFile
@graph.rdfs:comment: Whether this region has been written into the photo file's own XMP. Once a rescan finds the same name in the file's real EXIF regions, this region is replaced by the EXIF-derived one.

@graph.name: Specialization of
@graph.rdfs:label: prov:specializationOf
@graph.rdfs:comment: This crate's instance of the person depicted.

@graph.name: Name
@graph.rdfs:label: name
@graph.rdfs:comment: The EXIF field name, e.g. Make.

@graph.name: Value
@graph.rdfs:label: value
@graph.rdfs:comment: Its value, as text.

@graph.name: Name
@graph.rdfs:label: name
@graph.rdfs:comment: The person's name, or "Ignored stranger" for a permanently-suppressed face.

@graph.name: About
@graph.rdfs:label: about
@graph.rdfs:comment: The person this is a reference for. Absent entirely for a stranger. No range: the person is described in the main collection crate, not here, so it cannot be checked within this crate.

@graph.name: Source image
@graph.rdfs:label: sourceImage
@graph.rdfs:comment: The photo it was computed from, as a collection-relative path.

@graph.name: Source region
@graph.rdfs:label: sourceRegion
@graph.rdfs:comment: The region it was computed from. Absent for a stranger, which is never written back as a region.

@graph.name: Embedding
@graph.rdfs:label: embedding
@graph.rdfs:comment: The model's own vector.

@graph.name: Embedding model
@graph.rdfs:label: embeddingModel
@graph.rdfs:comment: The model that produced it.

@graph.name: Embedding model version
@graph.rdfs:label: embeddingModelVersion
@graph.rdfs:comment: Its version — a bump makes every reference obsolete, which is why it is recorded per entity.

@graph.name: Description
@graph.rdfs:label: description
@graph.rdfs:comment: Biographical notes about this person

@graph.name: Birth date
@graph.rdfs:label: birthDate
@graph.rdfs:comment: Date of birth for this person, to the maximum available precision - can use data ranges if this is not known

@graph.name: Name in file
@graph.rdfs:label: nameInFile
@graph.rdfs:comment: The name the photo file's own tag gives this region, recorded only where it differs from the name the crate keeps. Its absence means the two agree.

@graph.name: Spouses
@graph.rdfs:label: rico:relationConnects
@graph.rdfs:comment: The two people who are, or were, married to each other. Neither comes first: this relationship reads the same from either side.

@graph.name: Parent
@graph.rdfs:label: rico:relationHasSource
@graph.rdfs:comment: The parent. RiC orients this relationship from the parent, so the parent is its source.

@graph.name: Child
@graph.rdfs:label: rico:relationHasTarget
@graph.rdfs:comment: The child, who is the target of the relationship.

@graph.name: Began
@graph.rdfs:label: rico:beginningDate
@graph.rdfs:comment: When it began, to whatever precision is known — a year on its own is fine.

@graph.name: Ended
@graph.rdfs:label: rico:endDate
@graph.rdfs:comment: When it ended, if it has. Left out while it still holds.

@graph.name: RO-Crate Metadata Descriptor identifier
@graph.description: The fixed @id of the RO-Crate Metadata Descriptor.

@graph.name: Annotation motivations
@graph.description: Why a standoff region exists: it identifies someone.

@graph.name: identifying
@graph.description: The motivation for when the user intends to assign an identity to the Target or identify what is being depicted or described in the Target.

@graph.name: RO-Crate Photo Collection Profile
@graph.description: Photograph collections kept at rest on a filesystem as nested RO-Crates: a root crate describing the collection and the people in it, a crate per sub-collection of photos, and a companion crate of face-recognition reference data. Uses schema.org plus the W3C Web Annotation vocabulary for faces confirmed by the application itself.
